QUOTE: "the deny-list check in `ServerManager::execute` comes second, right before routing." and "`ServerManager::execute` ├─ is_denied(tool, pattern) ───► "Error: Permission denied" └─ route_tool_call"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the deny list is checked in ServerManager::execute, but it also describes an approval layer in ToolExecutor that can block calls ("otherwise ─► Permission denied"), so it never concludes the deny list is the only blocker.
